task.description: Step 0.5 (registry lookup) and Step 1 (diagnose) for ISS-0400, per WF-03. ISS-0400's own record (docs/issues/ISS-0400.yaml) already names the affected function (Letflow.Engine.Transition.collect_leaf_gateways/3), the affected file, and the mechanism (a PARALLEL_GATEWAY node is currently always treated as an immediate terminal leaf during the Tarjan-SCC memoized DFS walk, which is correct for the outer split's own join search but means a genuinely nested PARALLEL_GATEWAY split/join pair inside one branch of an outer split cannot be resolved -- the outer find_matching_join/2 call has no way to first resolve the inner pair and treat its result as a single leaf). Do not take that description as sufficient on its own (No Speculation, HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md section 1.1): reproduce the failure directly -- construct or locate a graph fixture with a PARALLEL_GATEWAY nested inside one branch of an outer PARALLEL_GATEWAY split (before that branch reaches the outer join), run it through the current collect_leaf_gateways/3 / find_matching_join/2 path, and confirm the actual failure mode (which error, or which silent-wrong-answer, results) rather than assuming the yaml's prose is exactly right. Then produce a root-cause diagnosis: which function needs to change, what invariant is missing, and what shape a fix needs (e.g. does the outer walk need to recursively resolve an inner split/join pair before treating its result as one leaf, and if so what does 'resolve' mean precisely -- a recursive call to the same join-finding logic, scoped to the inner PARALLEL_GATEWAY's own reachable subgraph). Do NOT implement the fix. Step 0.5: also check docs/issues/*.yaml for any other resolved entry describing the same or a closely related symptom (ISS-0398 itself is the obvious related entry, already linked -- read its own resolution and design doc so the diagnosis doesn't duplicate work) before writing the diagnosis.
